Row.Text: Makes mod settings survive a restart. The game answers every saved-settings read with the first entry it stored, whichever mod asked, so options panels lose what they saved and can overwrite each other. Tower Settings Keeper keeps every mod's entry inside the one row the game reads correctly and answers every read and write from it, in the main menu and in the game. Works with mods that have not been updated for it. No settings of its own.

Entries the keeper could not tell apart sit ahead of the shared settings, so it is keeping settings in a fallback layout. Rebuilding deletes those entries and writes everything the keeper holds back as one entry. Every mod's settings and keys the keeper holds are kept.
{1_Count} stored entries the keeper could not tell apart will be deleted. Every mod's settings and keys the keeper holds are kept. This cannot be undone.
